title: Inference for Treatment Effects Conditional on Generalized Principal Strata using Instrumental Variables
abstract: arXiv:2411.05220v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We propose a general approach to inference for a broad class of models that arise in the analysis of treatment effects with discrete-valued treatments and instruments and a general-valued outcome. In addition to instrument exogeneity, the main substantive assumption in our class of models rules out certain response types by assuming that they occur with probability zero. Here, the response type refers to the vector of potential outcomes and potential treatments, and we refer to a set of possible values for the response type as a generalized principal stratum. Through a series of examples, we show that this framework encompasses a wide variety of assumptions that have been considered in the previous literature. Our framework allows inference on any treatment effect parameter that can be expressed as the expectation of a function of the response type conditional on a generalized principal stratum. translated_title: 基于工具变量的广义主分层条件处理效应推断
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种通用的推断方法，适用于处理效应分析中出现的一类广泛的模型，其中处理变量和工具变量为离散取值，结果变量为一般取值。除了工具变量外生性之外，我们这类模型中的主要实质性假设是通过假设某些响应类型以概率零出现来将其排除。这里，响应类型指的是潜在结果与潜在处理构成的向量，我们将响应类型的可能取值集合称为广义主分层。通过一系列例子，我们表明该框架涵盖了先前文献中考虑过的多种多样的假设。我们的框架允许对任何能够表示为“条件于广义主分层的响应类型函数的期望”的处理效应参数进行推断。我们开发了针对此类参数的推断方法（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 本文提出了一个基于工具变量的通用推断框架，通过假设某些响应类型以概率零出现来定义广义主分层，从而能够对条件于广义主分层的一类广泛的处理效应参数进行推断。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a general instrumental-variable-based inference framework that defines generalized principal strata by assuming certain response types occur with probability zero, enabling inference on a broad class of treatment effect parameters conditional on such strata.
